contest: Not one color: this page covers the eight By color contests themselves (prize +4 / +6 / +10 followers).

story.line: Grey members each bend one table rule for any cult; cloaks pay a small steady boon for doing your own color's thing; contests give each color its own race at round end, scored in cloak order.

lines.grey members: Rule benders any cult can buy with any colors (where you place, how many minions, turn order, what counts in a contest), so every shop has a wildcard and a trap.
lines.cloaks: A boon all game for your own color's action (Cory, Nov 6: "it all needs to be based on your own actions"), meant to pay about 10 to 12 a game and show the table what you're chasing.
lines.contests: Each color's own round-end race worth +4 / +6 / +10, so taking a color's spaces is also a fight for its prize.

story.greatGame: Round I: you pick a cloak for its boon and it sets which contest you score first; you take its color's spaces for the steady pay. Round II: a grey member like Dabblers ("Counts as 2 wild members.") or Spoilsport ("Round End: choose a contest; nobody wins it this round.") shows up and rivals fight over it because it tips a contest. Round III: the +10 prizes decide the game, so Spoilsport, Sore Loser and the Goes Last token for Purple's 'Went last' matter most; rivals block the contest leader's spaces.
freshStart: Purple Cloak: "Whenever you take the Goes Last token, +3 purple, and +2 more if you place the round's last minion." (pays on Purple's own fight; Claude's fill-in)
Magenta Cloak: "Whenever you steal, steal 1 more." (every steal felt, instead of +1 magenta; Claude's fill-in)
Silver contest: "Fewest silver, at least 1." (Cory's own Nov 3 idea; rewards giving it away)
Grey member, Line Cutters' slot: "Round Start: choose your place in this round's turn order." [4 any, worth 3] (tested on paper Nov 4, not shown to Cory)

cards.name: Party Crasher
cards.text: On Use, once per game: your next minion can be placed on a space a rival already took.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, a rival grabs Initiation ("Recruit a member in the shop costing 10 or less, for free. +1 red.") first; I use Party Crasher and take Initiation too, and get a free 10-cost member the rival thought they'd blocked.
cards.topCase: One use a game, so the top case is one doubled round III space: about a free 10-cost member, worth about 10 for 7 spent. Big, but once; doesn't break the game.
cards.ideaWhy: One rule bent once: you may share a taken space.
cards.ties: Makes blocking a space less safe for everyone, and spoils the read on the Purple 'Went last' contest and Green's 'Most minions on green' only by one placement.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 1 4:23pm: "make it 4" then "5*" (price raised on feel; answer it with counterplay, Nov 1 2:18pm).
cards.why: A real round III moment, but once a game and it only matters when the space you want is taken.

cards.name: Big Spender
cards.text: On Use, once per game: recruit twice this turn.
cards.bestTurn: Round II, two good members in the shop and 12 resources in hand; I recruit both on one turn before rivals can take either.
cards.topCase: Once a game: one extra recruit, usually a member worth 1 to 3 followers bought a turn early. Small; never breaks anything.
cards.ties: Does the same job as Blue's Recruit Twice ("Recruit an extra time this turn. +3 blue."), so it gives every cult a piece of Blue's verb.
cards.why: A once-a-game copy of Blue's own space; out of the 10-card deck already.

cards.name: Alchemists
cards.text: All your resources count as any when you recruit a member.
cards.bestTurn: Round II with 6 yellow and 3 silver and no red; I recruit a 4 red + 3 any red member anyway, paying all yellow and silver.
cards.topCase: Every recruit for the rest of the game ignores color, and it's worth 3 followers. No single turn feels big; the payoff is never being stuck. Doesn't break the game.
cards.ideaWhy: One rule: your colors stop mattering when you recruit.
cards.ties: Makes color-locked members easier for its owner and weakens the pull to take a color's spaces for its resource; it does Yellow's job of translating colors.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Oct 28 10:55pm: "Freelancer is good" (its old name; renamed Alchemist, Oct 28 11:14pm).
cards.why: Cory called it good, but it has no moment anyone sees, and it does Yellow's translating for every color.

cards.name: Extra Hand
cards.text: On Use, once per game: +1 minion this round.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, 5 minions plus this one: I place a sixth minion on Spree ("Recruit two extra times this turn. +6 blue.") after everyone else ran out of good spaces.
cards.topCase: One extra round III placement, worth about one strong space (roughly 6 to 10). Fair against its price of 10.
cards.ties: Does what Purple's Overtime ("+4 purple. +1 minion this round. Take the Goes Last token: that minion is placed after everyone else's.") does, without the token; and it can change who places the round's last minion for Purple's contest.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Oct 28 10:55pm: "Extra Hand stays."
cards.why: A clear round III payoff at a fair price; it is Overtime without the purple.

cards.name: Line Cutters
cards.text: You go first every round.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, the leader in followers holds Line Cutters, so instead of the trailing player going first, I take Initiation ("Recruit a member in the shop costing 10 or less, for free. +1 red.") with the first minion of the round.
cards.topCase: Every round, first pick of the newly opened spaces; worth 3 for 4, so it's mostly 3 followers cheap. Strong for a leader (it overrides 'fewest followers goes first'), but one first pick in a snake means the longest wait after.
cards.ties: Takes the catch-up seat away from the trailing player every round from round II, and shapes who ends up placing last for Purple's 'Went last' contest.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Oct 28 10:55pm: "basically a dead card round 3" (made cheaper); Nov 1 10:25am: "maybe we make it 3 members? it seems pretty weak now".
cards.why: Cheap followers with a real first pick; the first pick is the moment, the price makes it buyable.

cards.name: Launderers
cards.text: On Recruit: rearrange your resources into any mix of colors.
cards.bestTurn: Round II, 8 mixed resources; I recruit Launderers and turn them into 5 white + 3 any to buy a White member next turn.
cards.topCase: Once, on recruit: one full rearrange plus 3 followers. Fair; doesn't break.
cards.ties: Is Yellow's round III Makeover ("+4 yellow, then rearrange your resources into any mix of colors.") as a member, so any cult gets Yellow's verb.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Oct 28 10:55pm: "should let you completely redo all your money"; Oct 30: Makeover takes its effect, "Launderers stays as the guest version".
cards.why: A twin of Yellow's Makeover; out of the 10-card deck already.

cards.name: Ghost
cards.text: Worth 0 members. Whenever this member joins your cult, −5 followers.
cards.bestTurn: Round II, I hold Ghost and use Promote ("Swap any member with one in another cult or the shop costing up to 3 more. +3 red.") to swap it for a rival's 8-cost member: the rival loses 5 followers and I gain a good member.
cards.topCase: Each time it moves into a rival it costs them 5; with Anarchist ("On Use, once per round: swap any 2 members that cost the same, in any cult or the shop.") once a round, that's up to 3 hits of −5 in a game. Strong sting, not broken; with no swap card in play it is just a −5 for whoever buys it.
cards.ideaWhy: Only works with a card that moves members (Red's swaps, Anarchist, Magenta's Shake Down); alone it does nothing.
cards.ties: Gives every member-moving card a target and a reason to block; makes Shake Down ("Choose a rival. They choose one of their members costing 7 or less, then pay you its cost or you steal it. +1 magenta.") a trap for the thief.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Oct 29: "a demote, swap or Anarchist piece; its bot numbers don't count"; Nov 6: "ghost should stay 5 cost".
cards.why: Cory keeps defending it and it makes a real sting, but it needs another card to do anything.

cards.name: Dabblers
cards.text: Counts as 2 wild members.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, I'm one red member behind in Red's 'Most red members' and one set short in Yellow's; Dabblers counts 2 in both and I take both prizes (+10 each).
cards.topCase: Counts 2 toward every member contest at once (Red, Blue, Yellow sets via members, Big Tent-type cards): in round III that can tip two +10 prizes. Strong, and Cory's own rule makes it always count in the player's favor.
cards.ideaWhy: One simple rule, as Cory says.
cards.ties: Raises every contest that counts members (Red's, Blue's) and every 'color none of your members have' card; rivals fight over it.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 4 12:29pm: "no i like dabblers a lot… Its a very simply card." Never a replacement target.
cards.why: Cory loves it, and rivals fight over it because it tips member contests.

cards.name: Cheerleader
cards.text: Whenever you win a contest, +1 follower.
cards.bestTurn: Round III I win Purple's 'Went last' and White's 'Fewest followers': +2 on top of the prizes.
cards.topCase: Win about 2 contests a round: about +6 a game. Flat; never breaks.
cards.ideaWhy: One rule, but a +1 nobody notices.
cards.ties: Nudges contests a little; does the same as Cheerleaders ("Whenever you win a contest, +2 followers.") at half the size.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 7 9:18pm: "cheerleader will go there and copycats will go there" (the future contests color).
cards.why: Cory moved it to the future contests color; Cheerleaders does the same thing bigger.

cards.name: Cheerleaders
cards.text: Whenever you win a contest, +2 followers.
cards.bestTurn: Round III I win White's 'Fewest followers' (+10) and Cheerleaders adds +2.
cards.topCase: Win 2 contests a round all game: +12, plus worth 3. Fair; the extra rides on prizes you'd chase anyway, so it never feels like its own turn.
cards.ideaWhy: One rule: winning a contest pays a bit more.
cards.ties: Makes its owner want every contest a little more, so rivals block a contest leader a little harder; no new piece touched.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 4 12:29pm: "though cheerleaders is kinda cool too"; 12:49pm: "Lets do cheerleaders for now"; 3:47pm: "for now they go in as-is".
cards.why: A +2 riding on a +4/+6/+10 prize is not a moment; bot owners won 19% (Nov 4), and it's a contests card waiting for the contests color.

cards.name: Anarchist
cards.text: On Use, once per round: swap any 2 members that cost the same, in any cult or the shop.
cards.bestTurn: Round II, a rival's 7-cost member wins them Red's contest; I swap it with a 7-cost shop member that does nothing for them, or with my Ghost ("Worth 0 members. Whenever this member joins your cult, −5 followers.") if it costs the same.
cards.topCase: Once a round for the whole game: 3 swaps, each one a member in or out of any cult; with Ghost up to −15 for rivals. Strong but bounded by equal costs.
cards.ties: Moves members between cults and the shop, which is Red's verb on Promote ("Swap any member with one in another cult or the shop costing up to 3 more. +3 red.") and Demote ("Swap any member with one in another cult or the shop costing up to 3 less. +3 red."); it changes Red's and Blue's member contests.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 4 11:07am: "yes anarchist counts as a recruit btw."
cards.why: A real reason to fear a rival's turn, but it does Red's swapping for any cult.

cards.name: Spoilsport
cards.text: Round End: choose a contest; nobody wins it this round.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, the leader is about to win Red's 'Most red members' for +10 and the game; I spoil it and nobody gets the 10.
cards.topCase: Once a round: in round III it cancels a +10, in a close game the swing that decides it. Strong; not broken, since it can't give you anything.
cards.ties: Every contest leader has to watch the Spoilsport holder; it hits whichever color's race matters most.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 4 12:50pm: "I love spoilsport it should stay"; Nov 6 9:34am: "lets just make spoilsport 'choose a contest'".
cards.why: Cory loves it, and it makes the whole table look at its holder in round III.

cards.name: Con Men
cards.text: On Recruit: steal 5 resources.
cards.bestTurn: Round II, a rival saved 9 for a big member; I recruit Con Men, take 5 of it, and they can't buy it this turn.
cards.topCase: Once on recruit, but Green's copy spaces repeat it: one game fired it 7 times through copies (35 resources). Big; Cory saw that and kept it.
cards.ties: Is Magenta's stealing on a grey card, so any cult can steal 5 without Magenta; feeds the Magenta Cloak ("Whenever you steal, +1 magenta.") if its holder has it.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 1: "i like con men"; Nov 6 2:36pm: "i love conmen" (stays as is, copies included).
cards.why: Cory loves it; one big steal everyone feels.

cards.name: Coach
cards.text: On Recruit: activate one of your members’ On Use ability as a free extra use.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, I already used Extra Hand ("On Use, once per game: +1 minion this round."); Coach gives me its minion again.
cards.topCase: Once; as good as your best used On Use member, usually worth 3 to 8. With nothing to reuse it's worth 1 follower for 9.
cards.ideaWhy: Only as good as another member you own; a bonus on someone else's card.
cards.ties: Pushes buying On Use members of any color; nothing shared beyond that.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 1 12:00am: "take out Coach" (from the 10-card deck).
cards.why: Cory cut it from the 10-card deck; it needs another member to do anything.

cards.name: Sore Loser
cards.text: Round End: if you win no contest, steal 5 followers from the rival who wins the most.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, I win nothing and the leader wins three prizes; I take 5 followers from them, a 10-follower swing.
cards.topCase: Every round you win nothing: a 10-point swing in your favor, 30 over a game if you lose every contest. Strong as catch-up; it rewards losing, which can be played on purpose.
cards.ideaWhy: One rule: lose them all and you rob the winner.
cards.ties: Gives the trailing player a reason to stop chasing contests and a sting for whoever wins the most; it pushes against White's 'Fewest followers' prize, which already helps the trailing player.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 4 11:27am: "sore loser should steal more followers" (raised 3 to 5).
cards.why: A real sting on the contest leader; a contests card that waits for the contests color.

cards.name: Tiebreaker
cards.text: You win every contest tie you’re in.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, I tie for Blue's 'Most members'; instead of half of 10 (5), I get all 10.
cards.topCase: Only on ties: a round III tie is +5 over sharing. Rare; flat most games.
cards.ties: Breaks ties in every contest, so tied rivals lose half a prize they'd have split.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 1 12:00am: "Tiebreaker can also come out" (from the 10-card deck); Oct 28: "maybe should be a little cheaper. 4?".
cards.why: Cory took it out of the 10-card deck; it only matters on a tie.

cards.name: Red Cloak (Recruiter)
cards.text: Whenever you recruit a member, +1 red.
cards.bestTurn: Round II I recruit twice with Big Spender ("On Use, once per game: recruit twice this turn."): +2 red, enough to finish the next red member.
cards.topCase: About 10 red a game (24 Normal games, Nov 7), right at Cory's 10 to 12 target. Steady, never big.
cards.ties: Pushes its holder to buy members over buying followers, which feeds Red's 'Most red members' race.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 6 9:36pm: "Red good".
cards.why: On target and on theme, but a +1 nobody notices.

cards.name: Green Cloak (Impressionist)
cards.text: Whenever you copy an action or a member, +2 of its color (grey: any color).
cards.bestTurn: Round III on Greatest Hits ("Copy the On Recruit of each of your members, in any order. +1 green.") with 4 On Recruit members: +8 of their colors on top of the copies.
cards.topCase: About 13 a game, second highest; a Greatest Hits turn can pay 8 to 10 at once. High but not broken.
cards.ideaWhy: Copy, get the color you copied.
cards.ties: Pays in the copied space's or member's color, so Green's copying hands its holder other colors' resources.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 6 9:36pm: Green good, "Maybe needs to be Action or Member to be fair. keep in mind the new grey rule".
cards.why: A real payoff turn on Greatest Hits; a little over target.

cards.name: Blue Cloak (Bargain Bin)
cards.text: Whenever you discard a member, +1 of its color (grey: any color).
cards.bestTurn: Round I on Out of Style ("Send every shop member of one color to the discard pile, then refill. +1 blue per member sent. +1 blue."), I send 3 red members away: +3 red on top of the space's +4 blue.
cards.topCase: About 10 a game after Cory's cut from +2; batch discards still pay 3 or 4 at once. On target.
cards.ideaWhy: Discard a member, get its color.
cards.ties: Turns the discard pile into resources in other colors, and makes clearing the shop a little better for the holder.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 7 11:08am: "are you SURE the blue cloak isnt too strong? 2 resources for EVERY member"; 11:28am: "Just give one color of the member discarded PER EACH DISCARDED. greys are wild".
cards.why: Cory's own number; on target with a small burst on batch discards.

cards.name: Magenta Cloak (Fence)
cards.text: Whenever you steal, +1 magenta.
cards.bestTurn: Round I on Help Yourself ("Steal 3 resources in round I, 4 in round II, 5 in round III from one rival."): 3 stolen plus 1 magenta.
cards.topCase: About 9 a game; each steal adds 1. Under target, never felt.
cards.ties: Pushes stealing a little more; feeds Magenta's 'Most resources' contest by 1 per steal.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 6 11:07pm: "+1 probably too weak".
cards.why: Cory himself called +1 too weak; nobody at the table feels a 1.

cards.name: Purple Cloak (Pocket Watch)
cards.text: Whenever you take the Goes Last token, +3 purple.
cards.bestTurn: Round III on Sleep In ("+4 purple in round I, +5 in round II, +6 in round III. Take the Goes Last token: your next minion is placed after everyone else's."): +6 purple, +3 more from the cloak, and the last minion wins Purple's 'Went last' contest.
cards.topCase: About 6 a game, the lowest of every cloak: only Sleep In, Last Call and Overtime take the token.
cards.ties: Ties straight into the fight over the Goes Last token and Purple's 'Went last' contest.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 6 9:36pm: "when you take the Go Last token, +4 purple or something. Then we need to make sure there are at least a few ways to do it"; 11:07pm: "lets try +3".
cards.why: Pays least of all cloaks (about 6 against Cory's 10 to 12) because few cards take the token; his open ask is more ways to take it.

cards.name: Silver Cloak (Caterer)
cards.text: Whenever you gift silver, +2 silver.
cards.bestTurn: Round I on Toast ("+3 silver in round I, +6 in round II, +9 in round III. Each rival +1 silver in round I, +2 in round II, +3 in round III."): +3 silver, rivals +1 each, and +2 more from the cloak.
cards.topCase: Was about 17 a game at +3, the highest; at +2 about 11 to 12. On target now.
cards.ties: Every gift also feeds rivals' silver, so the cloak keeps its holder ahead in Silver's 'Most silver' contest.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 7: "Silver is crazy wtf.... Put silver to +2"; Nov 6: "let's do +2".
cards.why: Cory's own fix; on target and it rewards Silver's giving.

cards.name: Yellow Cloak (Guest Book)
cards.text: Whenever you recruit a member of a color none of your members have, +2 yellow.
cards.bestTurn: Round II on New Blood ("+2 yellow. This turn, if you recruit a member of a color none of your members have, +2 yellow in round I, +3 in round II, +4 in round III."): I recruit my first silver member: +5 yellow, +2 more from the cloak.
cards.topCase: About 11.5 a game; it caps itself at the number of colors (4 plus grey), so it can't run away.
cards.ties: Pushes buying one of every color, which feeds Yellow's 'Most full sets' contest.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 6 9:36pm: "Yellow good".
cards.why: The best fit to its color's story, and self-limiting; no big moment.

cards.name: White Cloak (Money Changers)
cards.text: Whenever you buy followers, +2 white.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, I buy 10 followers and get +2 white, then Cash In ("Turn all your white into followers. +1 white.") turns it into 2 more followers.
cards.topCase: About 9.5 a game, a bit under target.
cards.ideaWhy: It pays for buying followers while White's contest rewards having the fewest.
cards.ties: Pushes its holder to buy followers, which works against White's own 'Fewest followers' contest and Cory's 'fewer followers' direction for White.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 6 9:36pm: "down to try it" (+3); Nov 3: "buff white a touch".
cards.why: Steady and close to target, but it pulls against White's own contest.

cards.name: Red: Most red members
cards.text: Most red member cards at round end (each card counts 1, Dabblers 2). Prize +4 / +6 / +10 followers.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, tied 3-3 on red members; I use Demote ("Swap any member with one in another cult or the shop costing up to 3 less. +3 red.") to swap a rival's red member for a cheap blue one: 4-2, +10.
cards.topCase: One seat took it all three rounds in 1 to 2% of games (Nov 3); red cults won 38% of Hard games, down from 53%. Strong color, no lock.
cards.ties: Gives Red's swaps, Magenta's member steals and Anarchist a target every round.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 3 5:14pm: "we should avoid a simply color held. maybe most red members? the members need to be such that they aren't auto buys."
cards.why: Cory's own idea and it makes swaps matter; Red is still the strongest color.

cards.name: Blue: Most members
cards.text: Most members at round end (a member counting as 2 or more counts that many). Prize +4 / +6 / +10 followers.
cards.bestTurn: Round III on Spree ("Recruit two extra times this turn. +6 blue."), I recruit 3 members in one turn and pass the leader for +10.
cards.topCase: Rewards whoever recruits most; big members that count as 3 or 4 swing it. Doesn't break.
cards.ties: Overlaps Red's 'Most red members' (both count members) and pushes against White's 'fewer followers'.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 3: "those are good" (kept as listed).
cards.why: Fits Blue's extra recruits, but it is close to Red's contest.

cards.name: Green: Most minions on green
cards.text: Most of your minions on Green spaces at round end. Prize +4 / +6 / +10 followers.
cards.bestTurn: Round II, I take Build Up ("+3 green in round I, +4 in round II, +5 in round III.") and Sample ("Copy the On Recruit of a rival's member. +1 green."); two minions on Green, +6.
cards.topCase: Ties split often with only a few Green spaces open each round (80% of rounds shared before a tie-break, since removed). Flat.
cards.ties: Pulls minions onto Green's spaces, so copies and Green's own spaces get taken earlier; it says nothing about copying.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 3: "ties are split… like they already were…"; Nov 7: "you haven't really thought about how green connects to other things".
cards.why: Any minion on Green wins it, so it doesn't reward copying, and ties split often.

cards.name: Magenta: Most resources
cards.text: Most resources held at round end, every color together. Prize +4 / +6 / +10 followers.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, I Help Yourself ("Steal 3 resources in round I, 4 in round II, 5 in round III from one rival.") from the leader: a 10-point swing in the count, and +10.
cards.topCase: Every steal moves it twice (you up, them down). Rewards hoarding instead of buying. Doesn't break.
cards.ties: Makes every cult's saved resources a target and pushes holding over recruiting.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 4 12:36pm (on White): "I think in general i dont like 'most of X resource' anymore."
cards.why: A held-resource contest, the kind Cory said he no longer likes.

cards.name: Purple: Went last
cards.text: Whoever placed the round's last minion. Prize +4 / +6 / +10 followers.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, I take Sleep In ("+4 purple in round I, +5 in round II, +6 in round III. Take the Goes Last token: your next minion is placed after everyone else's.") with my fourth minion; my fifth goes last and wins +10 (plus +3 purple from the Purple Cloak).
cards.topCase: One winner a round, never a tie; whoever holds the Goes Last token at the end usually wins. Strong, clean race.
cards.ties: Is the fight over the Goes Last token, so Purple's turn-order spaces and Extra Hand ("On Use, once per game: +1 minion this round.") all bear on it.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 3: "purple should be whoever went last".
cards.why: Cory's own idea, and it is exactly Purple's fight over the token.

cards.name: White: Fewest followers
cards.text: Fewest followers at round end. Prize +4 / +6 / +10 followers.
cards.bestTurn: Round II, I hold off buying followers until the next round, sit lowest, and take +6.
cards.topCase: Goes to the trailing player; one player kept it all 3 rounds in 5% of games (Nov 3). A catch-up, not a runaway.
cards.ties: Rewards waiting to buy followers and cards that give followers later; pulls against the White Cloak ("Whenever you buy followers, +2 white.").
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 4 12:36pm: "it should stay 'fewest followers'".
cards.why: Cory chose it twice; a clean catch-up that makes when you buy followers a real choice.

cards.name: Yellow: Most full sets
cards.text: Most full sets of one of every color in play at round end. Prize +4 / +6 / +10 followers.
cards.bestTurn: Round III on Makeover ("+4 yellow, then rearrange your resources into any mix of colors."), I rearrange into 2 full sets and win +10.
cards.topCase: Rearranging spaces can make sets at will in round III, so the Makeover taker often wins it. Strong, not broken.
cards.ties: Pushes holding every color, so it touches every color's resource and Magenta's steals.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 3: "yellow should be sets of colors".
cards.why: Cory's idea and on Yellow's story; a held-resource count, which he's wary of.

cards.name: Silver: Most silver
cards.text: Most silver held at round end. Prize +4 / +6 / +10 followers.
cards.bestTurn: Round III on Toast ("+3 silver in round I, +6 in round II, +9 in round III. Each rival +1 silver in round I, +2 in round II, +3 in round III."): I jump 9 while rivals get 3, and win +10.
cards.topCase: Silver's own spaces give its taker more than they gift, so the Silver player usually wins. Flat as a race.
cards.ties: Silver's gifts feed rivals' silver too, which is the only tension; otherwise it is a held color.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 3: "silver should maybe be LEAST silver? idk. let's start with most."; Nov 4: "i dont like 'most of X resource' anymore".
cards.why: A held-color contest, the kind Cory said he no longer likes; he floated 'least silver' himself.

overlaps: Big Spender ("On Use, once per game: recruit twice this turn.") and Blue's Recruit Twice ("Recruit an extra time this turn. +3 blue.").

Launderers ("On Recruit: rearrange your resources into any mix of colors.") and Yellow's Makeover ("+4 yellow, then rearrange your resources into any mix of colors."); Alchemists ("All your resources count as any when you recruit a member.") also does Yellow's translating.
Extra Hand ("On Use, once per game: +1 minion this round.") and Purple's Overtime ("+4 purple. +1 minion this round. Take the Goes Last token: that minion is placed after everyone else's.").
Con Men ("On Recruit: steal 5 resources.") and Magenta's Help Yourself ("Steal 3 resources in round I, 4 in round II, 5 in round III from one rival.").

Anarchist ("On Use, once per round: swap any 2 members that cost the same, in any cult or the shop.") and Red's Promote ("Swap any member with one in another cult or the shop costing up to 3 more. +3 red.") and Demote ("Swap any member with one in another cult or the shop costing up to 3 less. +3 red.").
Cheerleader ("Whenever you win a contest, +1 follower.") and Cheerleaders ("Whenever you win a contest, +2 followers.").
